title.zh: 共享阅读角试点：会议简报
title.en: Shared Reading Corner Pilot: Meeting Brief

subtitle.zh: 虚构内部示例 · 区分已确认事项与待讨论提案
subtitle.en: Fictional internal example · Separate confirmed decisions from proposals

value.zh: 虚构日期：2030 年 4 月 12 日
协调组、资源组、反馈组（均为虚构）
value.en: Coordination, resources and feedback teams (all fictional)

notice.zh: 全部内容均为虚构，不含真实同事或学生信息。“仅限内部”标签不是访问控制；若实际部署内部资料，必须使用身份验证。
notice.en: All content is fictional and contains no real colleague or student information. The “Internal only” badge is not access control; actual internal hosting requires authentication.

lead.zh: 先验证空间与借阅流程，再决定是否扩大试点。
lead.en: Validate the space and borrowing process before deciding whether to expand.

text.zh: 同意先拟定一个小规模试点方案。尚未批准启动日期、采购预算或扩大范围。
text.en: The teams agreed to draft a small pilot plan. No launch date, purchasing budget or expansion has been approved.

items.zh: 资源组将盘点现有书籍，不收集读者个人信息。
items.en: The resources team will inventory existing books without collecting reader personal information.

items.zh: 反馈组将提出匿名反馈问题，供下次会议审阅。
items.en: The feedback team will propose anonymous feedback questions for review at the next meeting.

rows.zh: 草拟空间布置与借阅流程
rows.en: Draft space layout and borrowing process

rows.zh: 下次会议前；具体日期待确认
rows.en: Before the next meeting; exact date unconfirmed

rows.zh: 盘点现有书籍并列出缺口
已同意；截止日期待确认
提交匿名反馈问题草案
已同意；截止日期待确认

text.zh: “试行两周”和“增购书籍”仅为讨论提案。需要先确认时间安排与可用预算，不能作为已批准承诺对外表述。
text.en: A “two-week trial” and “additional book purchases” are discussion proposals only. Scheduling and available budget must be confirmed before presenting either as an approved commitment.

items.zh: 确认空间使用安排与管理责任。
items.en: Confirm space availability and management responsibility.

items.zh: 审阅反馈问题是否必要、清晰且不识别个人。
items.en: Review whether feedback questions are necessary, clear and non-identifying.

items.zh: 在方案通过后再确认启动日期。
items.en: Confirm the launch date only after the plan is approved.

text.zh: 下一次会议日期待确认。本简报没有记录个人姓名、真实会议来源或私密附件。
text.en: The next meeting date remains unconfirmed. This brief includes no personal names, actual meeting sources or private attachments.
